data.long_meaning: Janelle is a French name derived from the Hebrew Yehonah, meaning 'God is gracious'. In the Bible, the name Yehonah is borne by a Levite gatekeeper at the temple and by the wife of King Jehu. This name was also borne by a female character in the 19th-century French novel 'Claude et Janelle'.
